title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Copilot video creation in Video Hub, billed in Copilot Credits
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, credit billing and access requirements are supported, and the updated Anthropic documentation does not contradict its relevant claims. Two portal paths need their remaining steps, and the guidance on License Administrator editing permissions should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft documentation.

claims.claim: A uniform default arrival state for this Video Hub capability is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Clipchamp video creation default. Read roadmap, MC1560920, billing overview/setup/manage and Anthropic page: access requires both gates, but existing Auto-apply policies can add services and Anthropic defaults vary; no uniform feature default is given.

claims.claim: The feature's licensing model is consumption.
claims.quote: This is a usage-based billing (UBB) feature. Each video and subsequent refinements use Copilot Credits, billed through Copilot Credits usage-based billing in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The cost is variable because video creation and refinements are metered in Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: This is a usage-based billing (UBB) feature. Each video and subsequent refinements use Copilot Credits

claims.claim: The notice describes a user-driven prompt, preview, refine and export loop, not an action running without the user.
claims.quote: Searched: Clipchamp Copilot video creation default; read MC1560920 and roadmap in full. Their workflow is user prompt, in-chat preview, conversational refinement and Export; the notice describes no unattended action.

claims.claim: MC1560920 does not explain how other sensitivity-label settings apply to this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Clipchamp Copilot sensitivity video creation. Read MC1560920: its label guidance is the above-General download restriction. Search results describe MP4 and editor-project labeling, not additional label-setting behavior stated by this notice.
